subject.title: Gateway memory leak: 389MB → 14.7GB over 4 days with session accumulation

question: What representative current-main RSS/heap profiling proof is sufficient to close this broad Gateway memory tracker after the existing narrow mitigations?
rationale: The codebase has several partial fixes, but deciding the soak workload, required artifacts, and whether the remaining contributors are split or complete requires maintainer ownership of the closure bar.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker Open
options.body: Continue using this issue as the canonical multi-day Gateway RSS/OOM tracker until focused fixes and representative soak proof show stable RSS.

options.title: Split Into Focused Trackers
options.body: Move remaining contributors into narrower canonical issues while preserving this issue's field reports by cross-linking them.

options.title: Close After One More Mitigation
options.body: Close after a selected narrow PR lands, accepting that newer field reports may remain unproven against current main.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker Open
recommendation.body: Continue using this issue as the canonical multi-day Gateway RSS/OOM tracker until focused fixes and representative soak proof show stable RSS.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and authored the maintainer comment that set the current representative-soak closure bar.
